parameters.jsCode:
const input = $input.item.json;

// Generate a deterministic Markdown preview
const preview = [
  '## 📋 Support Ticket Preview',
  '',
  '**Customer Information**',
  '',
  `- Email: ${input.customer_email}`,
  `- Order ID: ${input.order_id || 'N/A'}`,
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  '**Issue Details**',
  '',
  `- Issue type: ${input.issue_type}`,
  `- Issue summary: ${input.issue_summary}`,
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  '**Status: ⏳ Awaiting Confirmation**',
  '',
  'Please review the information above.',
  '',
  'If the details are correct, reply with:',
  '',
  '**CONFIRM SUPPORT TICKET**'
].join('\n');

// Return preview and normalized ticket data
return {
  json: {
    ...input,
    success: true,
    status: 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION',
    ticket_id: null,
    preview_markdown: preview,
    message: preview
  }
};
